verdict.rationale: Veriff documents its own PEP & Sanctions, adverse media and ongoing monitoring services. Results come back through a dedicated watchlist-screening webhook, and pricing lists PEP & Sanctions as a per-verification add-on, which suggests screening attaches to the same verification. The evidence does not show screening hits being reviewed in the same Customer Portal surface used for verification sessions, nor how screening is requested within the session API. missing for 10: documented review of watchlist hits in the Customer Portal, explicit session-API parameters for requesting screening in the same verification, adverse-media pricing/config detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface

citations.quote: This webhook returns data from Veriff PEP and Sanctions, adverse media (AM) checks and ongoing monitoring (OGM) services.
In Veriff Customer Portal you have two options: Open the session on the Verifications page, or Go to Verifications page → Webhooks tab and open webhook's Details
